plain: Nick Bostrom's idea that some level of technology makes it easy enough to destroy civilisation that it will happen by default unless the world is policed very differently.
eli5: The worry that one day someone will invent a toy so dangerous that anyone could break the whole playground with it.
technical: Bostrom's (2019) hypothesis that there is some level of technological development at which civilisation almost certainly gets devastated by default, absent extraordinary preventive policing or global governance.
